LEASE AGREEMENT

Landlord: ABC Properties
Tenant: XYZ Corp

Premises: Suite 100, 500 Main Street – about 2,000 square feet.

Term: 3 years, starting July 1, 2026.

Rent: $10,000/month, due on the 1st.

Rent Increase: Rent goes up every year by either 2% or inflation – whichever is more.

Utilities: Tenant pays for electricity and water.

Repairs: Tenant must fix anything that breaks.

Termination: Either party can end this lease with 30 days' notice
This Services Agreement is between Lion City Pte. Ltd., the service provider, and Dana Lim, the customer. The initial term starts on 04/03/2026 and continues for twelve months.
This agreement between Harbour Works Pte. Ltd. and Northstar Ltd. starts on 15 August 2026 and ends 30 days after final delivery.
